WITH avg_qty AS (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) AS threshold
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem
JOIN part ON p_partkey = l_partkey
JOIN avg_qty ON avg_qty.l_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey
WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND l_quantity < avg_qty.threshold
LIMIT 1;

WITH filtered_parts AS (
    SELECT p_partkey
    FROM part
    WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#25' AND p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
),
part_thresholds AS (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS qty_threshold
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_partkey IN (SELECT p_partkey FROM filtered_parts)
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem
JOIN filtered_parts fp ON lineitem.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey
JOIN part_thresholds pt ON lineitem.l_partkey = pt.l_partkey
WHERE lineitem.l_quantity < pt.qty_threshold
LIMIT 1;
